items.source: Implementation of an observer which checks for Spring Data repository types and stores them in repositoryTypes for later registration as bean type.
items.translation: 实现一个观察者，用于检查 Spring Data 仓库类型并将其存储在 `repositoryTypes` 中，以便稍后注册为 Bean 类型。

items.source: Provides access to all repository types as well as their qualifiers.
items.translation: 提供对所有仓库类型及其限定符的访问。

items.source: Registers the given CdiRepositoryBean for further general treatment by the infrastructure.
items.translation: 将给定的CdiRepositoryBean注册到基础设施中，以便进行后续的一般性处理。

items.source: Registers the given CdiRepositoryBean for further general treatment by the infrastructure. In particular, this will cause repositories to be instantiated eagerly if marked as such.
items.translation: 将给定的 CdiRepositoryBean 注册到基础设施中以便进行后续的一般性处理。特别是，如果标记为需要急切实例化，这将导致仓库被急切地创建。

items.source: Base class for Extension implementations that create instances for Spring Data repositories.
items.translation: 为创建 Spring Data 存储库实例的`Extension`实现提供基类。
